title: Thanks For Voting
body:
Thousands of community members reviewed presentations and voted to help us pick the presentations for The Vancouver Summit.

For the next step, the OpenStack Track Chairs are working diligently to review all submissions, using the voting data as one piece of input in the selection process. Our goal is to create an amazing summit experience with well-rounded, impactful content.

If you submitted a presentation for consideration, you should receive an email in the next two weeks letting you know the status of your presentation and whether or not it was chosen for inclusion in the schedule or selected as an alternate.

Once the selections have been made, the summit schedule will be posted at openstack.org/summit.

We look forward to seeing you in Vancouver!
